text:
incident-bot: PAGER: Elevated 5xx rate observed for /v1/generate (us-east-1, eu-west-1). Error spike started ~1739004200. Current 5xx rate: ~12%. Affected capacity: inference model-runner pods in region clusters. Paging oncall: @maria. Please join: https://status.redwood.internal/incidents/1739004321 :rotating_light:

maria: On it. Acked pager, joining. Can someone grab the initial query samples and top error traces?

jin: grabbing logs from model-runner instances now. Seeing repeated segfaults in model_runner shared library (quant attention path). Pid traces attached.

ops_alex: I can start draining unhealthy nodes in us-east-1 if we want to reduce customer impact. Any preference for soft or hard drain?

samir: If segfault is in quant-attn kernel, fallback to the CPU-quantized variant or lighter model might avoid the crash. Recommend immediate routing to model-small-quant for new requests while we debug.

maria: Good call. Jin, paste the stacktrace snippet you see. Ops, prepare drain but hold until we confirm routing change.

jin: paste: ```
[2026-03-17T14:25:03Z] model_runner[2891]: segfault at 0x7f2a3bff8 ip 0x7f2a1c3b4 sp 0x7ffd7c9c
#0  0x7f2a1c3b4 in quant_attention::compute(...) +0x34
#1  0x7f2a1d4f0 in run_forward(...) +0x1f2
#2  0x55a7d4c3 in inference_loop +0x2a
```

jin: Also seeing OOM on a few pods prior to segfaults (RSS ~ 14GB on a 16GB GPU) — possibly memory growth then kernel crash.

maria: Ok. Samir, can you flip routing for traffic hitting /v1/generate to model-small-quant in routing layer? Set a 5m TTL and monitor error rate. Ops, stand by to drain any nodes that continue to crash.

samir: Routing change applied: /v1/generate -> model-small-quant (traffic split 100%) with TTL 5m. Confirmed in control plane: route_id=route-6821.

oncall-bot: ROUTE_CHANGE: route-6821 applied by samir at 1739004420.

maria: Monitoring metrics... please post error rate numbers in 1min. Also start recording customer impact: percentage of requests failing in last 15m and top tenants affected.

ops_alex: Kicking off node drains for three nodes in us-east-1 that report repeated restarts. Drains will respect in-flight windows.

jin: After routing flip, new logs show no segfaults for new inference requests. Old pods still crash when scheduled. Error rate started dropping.

maria: status?

samir: 5xx rate fell from 12% -> 1.2% over two minutes. Latency slightly higher (+80ms) on model-small-quant but acceptable.

cs_olivia: Notifying CS about degraded service window and mitigation. Preparing customer message draft for accounts with SLA concerns.

maria: Good. We'll keep route change for 15m while we stabilize, then do a controlled rollout back to primary model if safe. Jin, collect core dumps and upload to the incident board for engineers. Include exact pod ids.

jin: Uploaded cores to https://internal.artifacts.redwood/1739004321 and added attached pod list: model-runner-5f7c, model-runner-9b2d, model-runner-2a1f. Cores show invalid pointer in attention kernel; suspect regression in last quant-patch.

maria: Any ongoing customer errors reported?

cs_olivia: Two enterprise customers reported increased latency during the routing window; no request failures since routing change. I'll flag for account managers.

ops_alex: Drains completed, three crashing pods replaced, new pods remain stable on nodes with updated driver (we rolled GPU driver to 510.76 on two nodes yesterday). Need to correlate driver build.

maria: For now: 1) keep routing to model-small-quant 2) block deploys to quant-attention for models until postmortem 3) collect hotspots and reproduce locally 4) cs to notify affected customers with mitigation summary.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT_STATUS: Mitigated -> error rate <1.5% at 1739004720. Paging lifted for @maria.

maria: Thanks team. We'll do a follow-up postmortem. Assigning owners: jin -> root cause analysis / reproducer; samir -> routing rollback plan and automated fallback playbook; ops_alex -> node and driver correlation; cs_olivia -> customer comms + impact summary.

cs_olivia: Draft sent to AMs and posted to incident board. Suggested customer message: short summary, mitigation actions, ETA for fix.

maria: Closing live mitigation. Please update the incident page with timeline and attach all logs. We'll aim for a full postmortem in 48hrs. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT_UPDATE: Incident 1739004321 status=resolved_by_mitigation at 1739004921. Followup required: postmortem, deploy block on quant-attn, routing fallback playbook.
